purpose: 完整的怪物首遇提示、怪物叫声、特殊怪物说明与相邻怪物事件消息。

messages.context: First monster encounter / monster-shout complete source template; control prefixes remain outside translation
messages.en:
That monster is {monster}. You can learn about any monster by hovering your mouse over it, and read its description by <w>right-clicking</w> on it.
To attack this monster with your wielded weapon, just move into it. Note that as long as there's a non-friendly monster in view you won't be able to automatically move to distant squares, to avoid death by misclicking.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh:
那只怪物是{monster}。将鼠标悬停在怪物上可以了解它，<w>右键点击</w>则可阅读它的描述。
要用手持武器攻击它，只需朝它移动。只要视野中有非友善怪物，为避免误操作导致死亡，你就无法自动移动到较远的格子。

messages.context: First monster encounter / monster-shout complete source template; control prefixes remain outside translation
messages.en:
That {glyph} is a monster, usually depicted by a letter. Some typical early monsters look like <brown>r</brown>, <green>l</green>, <brown>K</brown> or <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>. You can gain information about it by pressing <w>x</w> and moving the cursor over the monster, and read the monster description by then pressing <w>v</w>. 
To attack this monster with your wielded weapon, just move into it.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh:
{glyph}是一个怪物，通常以字母表示。常见的初级怪物包括<brown>r</brown>、<green>l</green>、<brown>K</brown>或<lightgrey>g</lightgrey>。按<w>x</w>并将光标移到怪物上可以查看信息，再按<w>v</w>可阅读怪物描述。 
要用手持武器攻击它，只需朝它移动。

messages.context: First monster encounter / monster-shout complete source template; control prefixes remain outside translation
messages.en:
That {glyph} is a monster, usually depicted by a letter. Some typical early monsters look like <brown>r</brown>, <green>l</green>, <brown>K</brown> or <lightgrey>g</lightgrey>. Your console settings allowing, you'll always see a list of monsters somewhere on the screen.
You can gain information about it by pressing <w>x</w> and moving the cursor over the monster, and read the monster description by then pressing <w>v</w>. 
To attack this monster with your wielded weapon, just move into it.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh:
{glyph}是一个怪物，通常以字母表示。常见的初级怪物包括<brown>r</brown>、<green>l</green>、<brown>K</brown>或<lightgrey>g</lightgrey>。只要控制台设置允许，屏幕上总会显示一份怪物列表。
按<w>x</w>并将光标移到怪物上可以查看信息，再按<w>v</w>可阅读怪物描述。 
要用手持武器攻击它，只需朝它移动。

messages.context: First monster encounter / monster-shout complete source template; control prefixes remain outside translation
messages.en:
However, as a hunter you will want to deal with it using your bow. If you have a look at your shortbow from your <w>i</w>nventory, you'll find an explanation of how to do this. First <w>w</w>ield it, then follow the instructions.<tiles>
As a short-cut you can also <w>right-click</w> on your shortbow to read its description, and <w>left-click</w> to wield it.</tiles>
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh: 不过，作为猎人，你会想用弓来对付它。查看物品<w>i</w>栏中的短弓，就能看到如何使用弓的说明。先<w>w</w>装备它，再按说明操作。<tiles>你也可以<w>右键点击</w>短弓阅读其描述，并<w>左键点击</w>来装备它。</tiles>

messages.en: Uh-oh, some monster noticed you, either one that's around a corner or one that's invisible. Plus, the noise it made will alert other monsters in the vicinity, who will come to check out what the commotion was about.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh: 糟了，有只怪物注意到了你——它可能躲在拐角后，也可能隐形了。它发出的声响还会惊动附近的其他怪物，它们会赶来查看发生了什么。

messages.en: Uh-oh, that monster noticed you! Fortunately, it didn't make any noise, but many monsters do make noise when they notice you. That will alert other monsters in the area, who will come to check out what the commotion was about.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh: 糟了，那只怪物注意到你了！幸好它没有发出声响，但许多怪物注意到你时都会叫喊。这会惊动附近的其他怪物，它们会赶来查看发生了什么。

messages.en: {monster} didn't vanish, but merely moved onto a square which you can't currently see. It's still nearby, unless something happens to it in the short amount of time it's out of sight.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh: {monster}并未消失，只是移动到了你目前看不见的格子。它仍在附近，除非趁你看不见的这段时间发生了什么。

messages.en: That<console> {glyph}</console> is {monster}. While <w>technically</w> a monster, it's more like dungeon furniture, since it's harmless and doesn't move. If it's in your way you can attack and kill it like other monsters, but you won't get any experience for doing so.
messages.referent: monster is actual first-seen / shouting actor, never target or player; glyph and key markup immutable
messages.zh: 那<console> {glyph}</console>是{monster}。虽然<w>从技术上说</w>它是怪物，但更像地牢里的摆设，因为它无害且不会移动。若它挡路，你可以像攻击其他怪物那样杀死它，但不会获得经验。

messages.en:
A great and nightmarish lacertilian beast. It has many heads, and the potential to grow many more!

Hitting it with any bladed weapon bigger than a short blade risks lopping a head off and causing two more to grow in its place. Very large claws, such as trolls', are long enough to do the same. Only a weapon branded with flame will cauterise the wound and prevent more heads from growing.
messages.zh:
一头噩梦般的巨型蜥蜴类怪兽。它有很多个头，而且可能还会长出更多！

用任何比短刃更大的有刃武器击打它，都有可能砍掉一个头，并在原处长出另外两个。像巨魔那样的大爪子也足够长，同样会造成这种结果。只有带有火焰印记的武器才能灼烧伤口，阻止它长出更多头。

messages.en: A vampiric thrall bound into servitude by esoteric rituals. Though its rigid limbs give it an awkward gait, it moves with surprising speed, leaping upon its victims and leeching away their life essence with its vicious claws.
messages.zh: 被神秘仪式束缚、沦为吸血奴仆的怪物。尽管僵硬的四肢使它步态笨拙，它的行动却出奇迅速，会扑向受害者，用凶狠的爪子吸取其生命精华。

共享龙族引用，完整引用和出处来自 quote 数据库。
messages.en:
“On the other hand, Confucius is made to say to his disciples, ‘I know how
 birds can fly, how fishes can swim, and how animals can run. But the runner
 may be snared, the swimmer may be hooked, and the flyer may be shot by the
 arrow. But there is the dragon. I cannot tell how he mounts on the wind
 through the clouds, and rises to heaven. Today I have seen Lao-tsze, and can
 only compare him to the dragon.’”
    -Life of Confucius

“This Dragon had Two furious Wings
   Each one upon each Shoulder;
 With a Sting in his Tail as long as a Flail,
   Which made him bolder and bolder.
 He had long Claws, and in his Jaws
   Four and forty Teeth of Iron;
 With a Hide as tough, as any Buff,
   Which did him round environ.”

    -“An Excellent Ballad of a most dreadful Combat, fought between Moore of Moore-Hall, and the Dragon of Wantley”, retold by Ambrose Philips, _A Collection of Old Ballads. Corrected from the Best and Most Ancient Copies Extant. With Introductions Historical, Critical, Or Humorous_. 1723.
messages.zh:
“另一方面，据说孔子曾对弟子说：
 ‘我知道鸟能飞，鱼能游，兽能跑。但跑者
 可以被网住，游者可以被钓起，飞者可以被箭射落。
 唯有龙，我不知道它如何乘风云而上天。
 今日我见到了老子，
 只能将他比作龙。’”
    -《孔子传》

“这条龙生有两只狂暴的翅膀
   一边肩膀各一只；
 尾上有一根如连枷般长的毒刺，
   令他愈发胆大。
 他生有长爪，他的嘴里
   长着四十四颗铁牙；
 他的皮坚韧如牛皮，
   将他周身包裹。”

    -《关于摩尔厅的摩尔与旺特利的龙之间一场最可怕战斗的 绝妙歌谣》，安布罗斯·菲利普斯重述，《古歌谣集。 从现存最佳最古抄本校订。附历史、批评或诙谐的导言》。 1723年。

That monster is an orc. You can learn about any monster by hovering your mouse over it, and read its description by <w>right-clicking</w> on it.

test_cases.canonical:
A great and nightmarish lacertilian beast. It has many heads, and the potential to grow many more!

Hitting it with any bladed weapon bigger than a short blade risks lopping a head off and causing two more to grow in its place. Very large claws, such as trolls', are long enough to do the same. Only a weapon branded with flame will cauterise the wound and prevent more heads from growing.
test_cases.zh:
一头噩梦般的巨型蜥蜴类怪兽。它有很多个头，而且可能还会长出更多！

用任何比短刃更大的有刃武器击打它，都有可能砍掉一个头，并在原处长出另外两个。像巨魔那样的大爪子也足够长，同样会造成这种结果。只有带有火焰印记的武器才能灼烧伤口，阻止它长出更多头。

test_cases.canonical: A lump of sickly pustulent flesh, dripping with lethal acid.
test_cases.zh: 一坨长满肉瘤的恶心肉块，不断滴落着致命的强酸。

test_cases.canonical: A vampiric thrall bound into servitude by esoteric rituals. Though its rigid limbs give it an awkward gait, it moves with surprising speed, leaping upon its victims and leeching away their life essence with its vicious claws.
test_cases.zh: 被神秘仪式束缚、沦为吸血奴仆的怪物。尽管僵硬的四肢使它步态笨拙，它的行动却出奇迅速，会扑向受害者，用凶狠的爪子吸取其生命精华。
有8个头的九头蛇

test_cases.canonical:
“On the other hand, Confucius is made to say to his disciples, ‘I know how
 birds can fly, how fishes can swim, and how animals can run. But the runner
 may be snared, the swimmer may be hooked, and the flyer may be shot by the
 arrow. But there is the dragon. I cannot tell how he mounts on the wind
 through the clouds, and rises to heaven. Today I have seen Lao-tsze, and can
 only compare him to the dragon.’”
    -Life of Confucius

“This Dragon had Two furious Wings
   Each one upon each Shoulder;
 With a Sting in his Tail as long as a Flail,
   Which made him bolder and bolder.
 He had long Claws, and in his Jaws
   Four and forty Teeth of Iron;
 With a Hide as tough, as any Buff,
   Which did him round environ.”

    -“An Excellent Ballad of a most dreadful Combat, fought between Moore of Moore-Hall, and the Dragon of Wantley”, retold by Ambrose Philips, _A Collection of Old Ballads. Corrected from the Best and Most Ancient Copies Extant. With Introductions Historical, Critical, Or Humorous_. 1723.
test_cases.zh:
“另一方面，据说孔子曾对弟子说：
 ‘我知道鸟能飞，鱼能游，兽能跑。但跑者
 可以被网住，游者可以被钓起，飞者可以被箭射落。
 唯有龙，我不知道它如何乘风云而上天。
 今日我见到了老子，
 只能将他比作龙。’”
    -《孔子传》

“这条龙生有两只狂暴的翅膀
   一边肩膀各一只；
 尾上有一根如连枷般长的毒刺，
   令他愈发胆大。
 他生有长爪，他的嘴里
   长着四十四颗铁牙；
 他的皮坚韧如牛皮，
   将他周身包裹。”

    -《关于摩尔厅的摩尔与旺特利的龙之间一场最可怕战斗的 绝妙歌谣》，安布罗斯·菲利普斯重述，《古歌谣集。 从现存最佳最古抄本校订。附历史、批评或诙谐的导言》。 1723年。
